newsitem.title: USA: New York Times March ad volume falls.
newsitem.headline: New York Times March ad volume falls.

text.p: The New York Times Co said its advertising volume decreased in March and increased for the year-to-date periods at the New York Times and Boston Globe.
The advertising volume at the New York Times Co Regional Newspaper Group increased in March and year-to-date.
Ad volume results were as follows:
--The New York Times was down 2.2 percent in March and up 3.0 percent for the year-to-date.
--The Boston Globe was down 1.4 percent in March and up 4.2 percent for the year-to-date.
--The Regional Newspaper Group was up 1.0 percent in March and up 1.1 percent for the year-to-date.
